title: Terminal section identifications commute with etale transitions
statement: Let H be a sheaf of sets on R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], let U,V,W be etale objects over R [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let f:V to U, q:U to W, r:V to W be site morphisms with f.left followed by q.left equal to r.left. For X=U,V, combine terminal restriction [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-restriction] with terminal transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport] along q.left or r.left to obtain a_X. Then H(f opposite) followed by a_V equals a_U followed by the canonical section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for this triangle, evaluated on the inverse image of H along W to R and the terminal object over W.

proof.text: Apply the naturality of the chosen restriction isomorphism to the diagonal lift from the terminal object of V to U base changed to V. Postcompose the restriction unit equation with the restriction of this lift. The lift followed by the first projection is f.left, while the terminal-to-V identification has identity underlying map. Thus the unit for V to R, followed by diagonal restriction, equals H(f opposite) followed by terminal restriction. This equality is fully proved in terminalRestriction_unit using cancellation of an isomorphism, sheaf-map extensionality, and pullback.lift_fst.

Specialize the terminal cone compatibility theorem to T=V.left, p=V.hom, t=f.left, t0=r.left. The structure-map equalities are the over-morphism equations. Substitute the unit equation of step 1 and reassociate composition. The two terminal isomorphisms are their explicit composites by definition, giving the stated transition equation.

lean.statement: theorem etaleSetTerminalTransition {R : Scheme.{u}} (H : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U V W : R.Etale) (f : V ⟶ U) (q : U ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ W) (hr : f.left ≫ q.left = r.left) : H.obj.map f.op ≫ (etaleSetTerminalRestriction H V ≪≫ etaleSetTerminalTransport W.hom r.left V.hom (MorphismProperty.Over.w r) H).hom = (etaleSetTerminalRestriction H U ≪≫ etaleSetTerminalTransport W.hom q.left U.hom (MorphismProperty.Over.w q) H).hom ≫ etaleSetSectionComparison f.left q.left r.left hr ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback W.hom).obj H) (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W.left))
